name: How does Frasheski Construction manage communication during a multi-room remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does Frasheski Construction manage communication during a multi-room remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective communication is paramount during any multi-room remodel. Frasheski Construction assigns a dedicated project manager who serves as your primary point of contact, ensuring consistent updates and addressing any questions or concerns promptly. We establish a regular communication schedule, including on-site meetings, phone calls, or email updates, based on your preference. This approach, which is part of our established process clarity, keeps you informed about progress, upcoming milestones, and any necessary decisions throughout the entire construction phase, minimizing surprises.
acceptedAnswer.description: We manage communication with a dedicated project manager, providing regular updates and promptly addressing concerns via scheduled meetings, calls, or emails.
